tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Returns the caller's remaining Curagent credit balance and tier. Call this before analyzing to confirm available usage. Sandbox tier includes a free monthly analysis allowance; paid tiers use 1 credit per analysis.

tools.name: check_coverage
